hazards.text: Crypto family starts at 16 with CRYPTO_MSG_NEWALG, CRYPTO_MSG_DELALG, CRYPTO_MSG_UPDATEALG, CRYPTO_MSG_GETALG, CRYPTO_MSG_DELRNG and CRYPTO_MSG_GETSTAT in order, CRYPTO_MSG_MAX one below private ceiling, CRYPTO_NR_MSGTYPES covering base through max, CRYPTO_MAX_NAME fixing 64 bytes; GETSTAT and STAT are unsupported, use REPORT only.
Drive records map BIOS tables at fixed boot addresses and require packed layout; counts are single bytes, never assume natural alignment.
CRAMFS_FLAG_WRONG_SIGNATURE is reserved and must not enable behaviour; acceptance follows the CRAMFS_SUPPORTED_FLAGS mask.
COREDUMP_MARK_REQACK is 0, COREDUMP_MARK_MINSIZE is 1, COREDUMP_MARK_MAXSIZE is 2, COREDUMP_MARK_UNSUPPORTED is 3, COREDUMP_MARK_CONFLICTING is 4, with ceiling using bit 31.
Energy commands order get domains, get table, created, updated and deleted from one; state attributes order performance, frequency, power, cost and flags.

Middle codes use EM_MIPS_RS3_LE is 10, EM_MIPS_RS4_BE is 10, EM_PARISC is 15, EM_SPARC32PLUS is 18, EM_PPC is 20, EM_PPC64 is 21, EM_SPU is 23, EM_ARM is 40, EM_SH is 42, EM_SPARCV9 is 43, EM_H8_300 is 46, EM_IA_64 is 50, EM_X86_64 is 62, EM_S390 is 22; shared 10 cannot recover endianness.

PT_NULL is 0, PT_LOAD is 1, PT_DYNAMIC is 2, PT_INTERP is 3, PT_NOTE is 4, PT_SHLIB is 5, PT_PHDR is 6, PT_TLS is 7, PT_LOOS to PT_HIOS span 0x60000000 to 0x6fffffff, PT_LOPROC to PT_HIPROC span 0x70000000 to 0x7fffffff, PT_GNU_EH_FRAME is OS base plus 0x474e550, PT_GNU_STACK is OS base plus 0x474e551, PT_GNU_RELRO is OS base plus 0x474e552, PT_GNU_PROPERTY is OS base plus 0x474e553, PT_AARCH64_MEMTAG_MTE is proc base plus 2.
ET_NONE is 0, ET_REL is 1, ET_EXEC is 2, ET_DYN is 3, ET_CORE is 4, ET_LOPROC to ET_HIPROC span 0xff00 to 0xffff, PN_XNUM is 0xffff signalling overflowed section count.
PF_R is 4, PF_W is 2, PF_X is 1, combinable for readable, writable and executable mappings.

EI_MAG0 through EI_MAG3 are 0 to 3, EI_CLASS is 4, EI_DATA is 5, EI_VERSION is 6, EI_OSABI is 7, EI_PAD is 8, ELFMAG0 is 127 with ELFMAG1 to ELFMAG3 as E L F, ELFMAG joins escape plus ELF, SELFMAG is 4, ELFCLASSNONE is 0, ELFCLASS32 is 1, ELFCLASS64 is 2, ELFCLASSNUM is 3, ELFDATANONE is 0, ELFDATA2LSB is 1, ELFDATA2MSB is 2, EV_NONE is 0, EV_CURRENT is 1, EV_NUM is 2, ELFOSABI_NONE is 0, ELFOSABI_LINUX is 3, ELF_OSABI selects none.
NN_GNU_PROPERTY_TYPE_0 holds GNU while NT_GNU_PROPERTY_TYPE_0 is 5, distinguishing property notes.

EDDNR is 0x1e9 for one-byte count of data at EDDBUF is 0xd00 up to EDDMAXNR is 6, EDDEXTSIZE is 8, EDDPARMSIZE is 74, CHECKEXTENSIONSPRESENT is 0x41, GETDEVICEPARAMETERS is 0x48, LEGACYGETDEVICEPARAMETERS is 0x08, READ_SECTORS is 0x02, EDDMAGIC1 is 0x55AA, EDDMAGIC2 is 0xAA55, EDD_MBR_SIG_OFFSET is 0x1B8 stored at EDD_MBR_SIG_BUF is 0x290 up to EDD_MBR_SIG_MAX is 16 with count at EDD_MBR_SIG_NR_BUF is 0x1ea.

invariants.text: Binding sits above type in one byte; ELF_ST_BIND shifts right four for binding and ELF_ST_TYPE masks low four for type, with ELF32_ST_BIND, ELF32_ST_TYPE, ELF64_ST_BIND and ELF64_ST_TYPE aliasing the generic pair.
Relocation info packs index above type; ELF32_R_SYM shifts right 8 for index with ELF32_R_TYPE masking low 8, while ELF64_R_SYM shifts right 32 with ELF64_R_TYPE masking low 32.
Each header defines _LINUX_ELF_EM_H, _UAPI_LINUX_ELF_FDPIC_H and _UAPI_LINUX_ELF_H on first inclusion to prevent repeated definitions.
ELF32_FDPIC_LOADMAP_VERSION and ELF64_FDPIC_LOADMAP_VERSION are both zero, marking the initial revision readers accept and writers emit.

structs.text: Cramfs inode packs mode with owner, length with group, and name length with offset in three words; lengths and offsets scale by four, with zero for empty objects.
Superblock sequences magic 0x28cd3d45 with length, flags, signature, identity, volume name and root inode; identity holds checksum, edition, block and file counts.
Algorithm identity holds three 64-byte names for common, driver and module plus type, mask, reference count and flags.

Reports open with a 64-byte label; hash, cipher, block, aead and rng advertise sizes, while larval, compression, akcipher, kpp, acomp and signature carry label alone, with max bound combining descriptor and block sizes.
Quota record holds version, flags, mask, id, block and inode limits with usage, timers with warnings, and realtime fields; timers are zero within limits else refusal time.
File stats hold inode, 512-byte blocks and extents; quota status holds version, flags, user and group storage, incore count and timer and warning limits.
Device parameters pack length, flags, geometry, sectors, sizes, bus and interface choice, device choice, and checksum without padding.
Each drive holds device, version, support bits, legacy maxima and parameters; container holds 16 signatures, 6 drives and 2 one-byte counts.
Dynamic entries pair tag with a union of value or address; 32-bit uses 32-bit tag and payload, 64-bit uses 64-bit tag with extended value.
Relocations carry offset and index-plus-type; addend forms add a signed addend, with narrow widths for 32-bit and wide for 64-bit.

32-bit symbols order name, value, size, info, other and section while 64-bit moves info first; 32-bit program headers order type, offset, addresses, sizes, flags and alignment while 64-bit places type with flags first; never cast between widths.
File headers start with 16-byte identifier then type, machine, version, entry, offsets, flags, sizes, counts and string index.
Section headers carry name, kind, attributes, address, offset, length, link, info, alignment and entry size, wider in 64-bit.
